topArticle.title: DRC politician beaten to death after radio appearance about Ebola outbreak

Marie-Celestin Karondwa was attacked on Sunday after promoting measures to prevent spread of disease, his party says

A senior member of the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s ruling party was beaten to death on Sunday after appearing on a radio programme to raise awareness about the Ebola outbreak, a party representative has said.
Marie-Celestin Karondwa, the acting president of the Union for Democracy and Social Progress (UDPS) party’s federal executive committee in Butembo, a new hotspot for the outbreak, was attacked after taking part in a ​radio show during which he ‌promoted prevention measures for the disease, ‌the UDPS federation in the city said in a statement, Reuters reported.

topArticle.title: At least 27 dead after two mass shootings in South Africa, police say
topArticle.description:
Seventeen people killed near Johannesburg in suspected ‘illegal goldmining turf war’, as 10 killed in separate incident at barbecue venue near Cape Town
Two separate mass shootings near South Africa’s two biggest cities killed at least 27 people, as the country grapples with one of the world’s highest murder rates amid investigations into corruption and criminality within the police.
The South African police service said on Sunday that 17 people were killed on Saturday night when eight suspects armed with AK-47 assault rifles and pistols opened fire at a bar in Wedela township, about 50 miles south-west of central Johannesburg. At least 15 other people sustained gunshot injuries in that attack, police said.

Fighting escalates after Tigrayan rebels form new coalition aimed at overthrowing Abiy Ahmed government
There are growing fears of a return to civil war in Ethiopia after an offensive by fighters from Tigray into the neighbouring states of Afar and Amhara and the formation of a new rebel alliance aimed at overthrowing the government of the prime minister, Abiy Ahmed.
About 600,000 people died between 2020 and 2022 during a devastating war between the Ethiopian army and the political party and paramilitary group the Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF). Both sides are now accusing the other of triggering a return to open conflict.

Slinger Francisco, known on stage as the Mighty Sparrow and dubbed the “calypso king of the world”, has died aged 91.

Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast

Loved ones of a missing Australian trekker who was last seen nearly two weeks ago on a remote South American hiking trail are urging local authorities to help with the search.
A wide-scale sweep by a private rescue crew has so far failed to find any trace of 30-year-old Jordan Yap, who last made contact with friends and family on 14 September ahead of a planned 10-day solo trek along Peru’s Huayhuash mountain range, 400km north-east of Lima.

topArticle.title: Seoul summons Ukraine envoy over North Korean prisoner-of-war row
topArticle.description: Last week Zelensky revealed Ukraine had sent two captured North Koreans to South Korea - which Seoul says was meant to be a secret.
topArticle.titleJa: 北朝鮮捕虜問題でソウルがウクライナ大使を召喚
topArticle.summary: ウクライナが北朝鮮兵捕虜を韓国へ送ったことを巡り、韓国政府はウクライナ大使を召喚し、秘密が漏洩したことについて厳しく抗議しました。

topArticle.title: Stand-up comic released after being convicted of insulting Erdoğan
topArticle.description: Turkish comedian Deniz Göktaş also faces a travel ban but has been released due to time served.
topArticle.titleJa: エルドアン大統領侮辱で有罪判決のコメディアンが釈放
topArticle.summary: トルコのコメディアン、デニズ・ギョクタシュがエルドアン大統領侮辱罪で有罪判決後、服役期間により釈放されましたが、渡航禁止処分は継続です。

topArticle.title: Families welcome guilty verdict over Mali crash that killed 116
topArticle.description: Relatives of the victims tell the BBC they are relieved to finally have a ruling 12 years after the crash.
topArticle.titleJa: マリでの墜落事故で116人死亡、遺族が有罪判決を歓迎
topArticle.summary: 12年前に116人が死亡したマリでの航空機墜落事故に関する有罪判決を、遺族が安堵と共に歓迎しました。

topArticle.title: Czech Republic ready for Wembley 30 years after Euro '96
topArticle.description: The Czech Republic are returning to Wembley for a Nations League game with England, just over 30 years after their Euro '96 heartbreak there.
topArticle.titleJa: チェコ共和国、ユーロ'96から30年ぶりにウェンブリーで試合へ
topArticle.summary: チェコ共和国が、ユーロ'96での苦い思い出から30年以上ぶりにウェンブリーでイングランドとのネーションズリーグ戦に臨みます。

topArticle.title: Trump meets US-backed Venezuelan president for first time since Maduro seized
topArticle.description: Rodriguez was handpicked by Trump as leader of Venezuela was arrested and taken to the US
topArticle.titleJa: トランプ氏、マドゥロ氏拘束後初めて米国が支援するベネズエラ大統領と会談
topArticle.summary: トランプ氏が、マドゥロ氏拘束以来初めて、米国が支援するベネズエラの指導者と会談した。これはベネズエラ情勢における重要な動き。

topArticle.title: New wild cat species discovered - with only one known living member
topArticle.description: A spotted wildcat long mistaken for relatives has been identified as a new species in Bolivia.
topArticle.titleJa: 新しい野生のネコ科動物種が発見される — 既知の個体は1匹のみ
topArticle.summary: ボリビアで、これまで近縁種と誤認されていた新しい野生のネコ科動物種が発見された。既知の生存個体は1匹だけとされている。

topArticle.title: ‘Pay-by-the-day’ living in Pereira: The forgotten survivors of Colombia’s earthquake
topArticle.description: In Pereira, Colombia, earthquake survivors living in pay-by-the-day rooms now face homelessness, overcrowded shelters, illness, and a struggle to be counted.
topArticle.titleJa: コロンビアの地震で忘れられた生存者たち：ペレイラでの「日払い」生活
topArticle.summary: コロンビアのペレイラでは、地震の生存者たちが日払い部屋で暮らし、ホームレス、過密シェルター、病気、そして存在を認識されない苦境に直面している。

topArticle.title: Bangkok roads submerged as flood disaster declared
topArticle.description: Authorities said the heavy rains have subsided but the flooding is not yet over.
topArticle.titleJa: 洪水災害宣言後、バンコクの道路が水没
topArticle.summary: 洪水災害が宣言されたバンコクでは、豪雨は収まったものの、依然として道路が水没しており、市民生活に大きな影響が出ている。

topArticle.title: Watch: Luxury units uncovered inside an Indonesian prison
topArticle.description: A surprise inspection at the prison revealed apartment-like units appearing to house inmates, equipped with televisions, a gym and fridges stocked with alcohol.
topArticle.titleJa: 視聴：インドネシアの刑務所内で豪華な独房が発覚
topArticle.summary: インドネシアの刑務所を抜き打ち検査した結果、テレビ、ジム、酒が stocked された冷蔵庫などを備えたアパートのような豪華な独房が見つかった。

topArticle.title: Women protest in the streets of Delhi after string of sexual assaults
topArticle.description: BBC correspondent Azadeh Moshiri reports from Delhi, where hundreds of women are protesting.
topArticle.titleJa: 連続性的暴行事件を受け、デリーの街頭で女性たちが抗議活動
topArticle.summary: 連続的な性的暴行事件に抗議するため、デリーの街頭で数百人の女性たちがデモを行っており、社会的な注目を集めている。

topArticle.title: Xi got Trump's red carpet welcome - but not everything he wanted
topArticle.description: China wanted progress on trade, technology and Taiwan - but hasn't got as much as it would have hoped for.
topArticle.titleJa: 習主席はトランプ大統領のレッドカーペット歓迎を受けたが、全てが望み通りではなかった
topArticle.summary: 習主席はトランプ大統領から歓迎されたが、中国が望んでいた貿易、技術、台湾問題での進展は期待ほど得られなかった。

topArticle.title: New Zealand advances safe and inclusive trade with new contribution to STDF
topArticle.description: New Zealand has contributed NZ$ 300,000 (approximately CHF 140,000) to the Standards and Trade Development Facility (STDF) to help developing and least-developed countries, including in the Pacific, strengthen food safety and animal and plant health systems.
topArticle.titleJa: ニュージーランド、STDFへの新たな貢献で安全かつ包摂的な貿易を推進
topArticle.summary: ニュージーランドがSTDFに30万NZドルを拠出し、太平洋地域を含む開発途上国の食品安全・動植物衛生システム強化を支援する。
